202155.note: The pin sits in the gravel loop on the bench above the river, and the drawn road along the canyon reaches it.

251352.note: The pin is on the house among its outbuildings, and the drawn ranch lane ends there; the lane is drawn up to 10 m east of the visible track on its way in.

10132083.note: The pin is at the end of the drawn spur on the open ridge top, beside a small structure that looks like the lookout.

10192010.note: The pin is on the guard station's building in the meadow edge, with a short driveway (visible, about 30 m) to the drawn road along the creek.

232349.note: The pin is beside the hut in the clearing on the ridge, inside the drawn loop road that reaches it.

232402.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuildings at the meadow's edge, just below the drawn road. The listing's own point, 886 m northeast, is on an empty slope by the road, so the pin is the right one.

233133.note: The pin is on a small cabin in a gap in the forest, and the drawn spur passes 20 m east.

233151.note: The pin is on the cabin beside the highway, with a short visible lane to it from the junction about 40 m north.

233169.note: The listing's own point is on the old headquarters building, with cabins and a road to it; the pin was 2.7 km southeast in an empty juniper draw.

233271.note: The pin is on a small light-roofed building at the forest edge, with the drawn road 15 m east; the station's other buildings sit around the drawn turnaround just south.

233272.note: A gray-roofed cabin with a small outbuilding stands in a clearing 90 m south of the pin, where the drawn lane ends; the pin was under conifers by the highway.

233336.note: The pin is on the homestead's house among its outbuildings, and the drawn road passes right beside it.

233402.note: The lidar relief shows level ground with no building-shaped gap at the pin; the nearest gap is a round one about 10 m across, 60 m east, ringed by a bank, which reads as a tank or pond more than a cabin. The drawn road ends in the clearing 50 m south, which the relief shows as a turnaround. Nothing is plainly the cabin, so nothing moved or traced.

233726.note: The pin is on a small building under the trees, about 20 m above the drawn road, with a short track to it.

233740.note: The lidar relief and intensity show a flat, smooth patch about 25 m across at the pin, at the end of the drawn spur, which may be the cabin's clearing, but no building-shaped gap or roof, so the pin can't be confirmed. Redrew the river road past it (from the junction 120 m west to the bend 340 m south) onto the band the relief shows and the photo shows in the open, where the Forest Service line ran 10 to 25 m west of it.

233743.note: The lidar relief shows NFS Rd 2510 as a crowned band 60 m north of the pin, while the Census line ran 10 to 30 m south of it past the cabin; redrew the road from 230 m west to 200 m east of the pin onto the band (dropping the duplicate Duckabush Rd lines). At the pin the relief shows a smoother patch of ground but no building-shaped gap or pad that is plainly the cabin, so the pin isn't moved.

233888.note: The pin is on the ranch house above the creek, with its drive to the drawn road 40 m north.

233961.note: The pin is beside small cabin buildings in the creek bottom, and the drawn lane runs past it. The listing's own point, 370 m west, is on a bare slope by the road, so the pin is the right one.

234091.note: Full canopy: the pin is under tall firs where no building shows, and the drawn Census roads can't be checked through the trees.

234092.note: The lidar relief shows only forest floor at the pin, with no building-shaped gap, pad or clearing within 40 m, and the photo shows unbroken lodgepole pines, so the cabin can't be placed. The forest road to the north shows as a band 5 to 8 m south of its drawn line, and the drawn road south of the pin shows only as a faint strip 8 m off. Nothing traced, since the pin itself is unconfirmed.

234131.note: The pin is on the lookout building on the rocky summit, and the drawn road ends beside it.

234149.note: The pin is on the lookout building at the edge of the summit clearing, with the drawn road looping round it.

234158.note: The pin is on the lookout in its small summit clearing, and the drawn road climbs the ridge to it.

234187.note: The pin is on a small structure on the open summit. The drawn Census road zigzags up up to 20 m off the visible switchbacks and stops 40 m short of the lookout.

234189.note: The pin is on the lookout's buildings at the top of the meadow, and the drawn road ends beside them.

234240.note: The pin is on the small cabin in the meadow, and the drawn lane up from the highway reaches it.

234247.note: The listing's own point is on the lookout's white-roofed building in a clearing with a loop drive at the end of the drawn road; the pin was 800 m south in unbroken forest.

234248.note: The listing's own point is on the lookout's white-roofed building in a ridge-top clearing at the end of a dirt road; the pin was 1 km southeast in unbroken forest.

234278.note: The pin is beside a small cabin in the open pines, 15 m below the drawn loop road.

234288.note: The pin is on the red-roofed cabin above the reservoir shore, and the drawn lane ends at it.

234298.note: The pin is on the small cabin at the edge of the meadow, and the drawn road ends there.

234299.note: The pin is on the cabin in the creek-side clearing, 20 m above the drawn road along the valley.

234300.note: The pin is on the cabin inside its fenced yard, and the drawn road passes beside it.

234307.note: The pin is at the forest edge 25 m south of a small cabin, and the drawn lane in from the highway passes just north of it.

234309.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, with the drawn Census road 40 m east, drawn up to 15 m off the visible track; a short visible lane runs from the cabin to it.

234328.note: The pin is beside the cabin at the forest edge, and the drawn road along the meadow ends at it.

234331.note: The pin is on the cabin at the top of the meadow, and the drawn track up from the trailhead ends 15 m short of it.

234332.note: The pin is on the cabin below the lake, and the drawn Census road passes right beside it.

234333.note: The pin is on the cabin in the meadow, and the drawn spur ends at it.

234334.note: The pin is beside the lookout on the bare summit, and the drawn road up the open slope ends at it.

234336.note: The pin is on the cabin among the pines, and the drawn lane comes within 30 m along a visible track.

234337.note: The pin is on the cabin by the river, and the drawn Census road from the north follows the visible lane to it within about 8 m. The Census line on south of the cabin crosses open ground where no road shows, and the gravel lane east to the river isn't drawn.

234338.note: The lidar relief shows a small raised, levelled rectangle 3 to 10 m north of the pin with a gap in the ground returns in the intensity, and the photo a pale roof there through a gap in the trees, so the pin reads as the cabin. The drawn Giefer Creek Road ends 75 m west, and no lane to the cabin shows plainly in either layer. Nothing traced.

234342.note: The pin is on the cabin in the trees by the river, and the drawn driveway from the road ends 15 m north of it.

234343.note: The pin is on the cabin in a small clearing in the forest, and the drawn Forest Service road loops up to it.

234345.note: The pin is beside the guard station's buildings in their yard. The drawn Forest Service spur stopped 60 m short, so the lane from its end to the yard, plainly visible, is traced.

234351.note: The lidar relief shows the pin on the edge of the creek bottom, with only a small rounded mound about 6 m across 25 m south-west that may be a building but could as well be a rock or root mass; no pad, lane or plain building gap shows, and the photo shows only the shadowed burn. The drawn trail is 130 m north across the creek. Nothing traced.

234352.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, and the drawn road passes 10 m south of it.

234353.note: The lidar relief shows a levelled patch about 8 m across right by the pin, beside a crowned lane that passes its west side and meets the forest road 15 m north, but no plain building gap, and the photo shows only a small opening there; it may be the cabin's pad, but can't be confirmed. West of the pin the drawn Forest Service road runs 15 to 30 m north of the band the relief shows. Nothing traced, since the pin itself is unconfirmed.

234355.note: The pin is on the blue-roofed cabin in its clearing, and the drawn roads meet beside it.

234361.note: The pin is on the house in the ranch yard, with the drawn lanes round the yard following the visible tracks.

234365.note: The pin is on the small cabin beside a ranch yard, 50 m east of the drawn road; the short drive into the yard shows but isn't drawn.

234366.note: The pin is on the cabin beside the drawn road, which follows the visible gravel switchbacks.

234367.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuildings in a small clearing, and the drawn Forest Service spur ends at it.

234369.note: The lookout's square cab with its catwalk and tower shadow shows 95 m northwest of the pin, at the end of the drawn road's loop; the pin was on bare rock.

234373.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, and the drawn road ends beside it.

234375.note: The pin is on the blue-roofed cabin in a small clearing, and the drawn road along the creek passes 45 m south of it.

234378.note: The pin is at the foot of the bare slope just north of the drawn highway, where no cabin shows clearly; the buildings nearest it are across the highway in the trees.

234379.note: The pin is at the edge of a fenced clearing beside an RV area between two drawn roads, and no building shows plainly at it. The listing's own point, 3.4 km east, is in unbroken forest, so neither point is confirmed.

234388.note: The pin is on the cabin's light roof, and the drawn loop off the highway goes round it.

234389.note: The pin is at the top of the bare rock butte, where a small structure shows, and the drawn road climbs to it. The listing's own point, 1.2 km east, is in unbroken forest.

234402.note: The pin is on the guard station's building in a clearing, with a short visible drive to the drawn road 40 m east.

234403.note: The pin is on the lookout building in its summit clearing. The drawn road stopped 85 m short, so the dirt road on to the clearing, visible between the trees, is traced.

234406.note: Zoomed in, a dark-roofed cabin about 8 m square sits in the clearing with the pin at its south edge, and a short lane runs to it from the drawn road 25 m east; the pin is already right.

234417.note: The pin is on the lookout's buildings on the open summit, and the drawn roads loop round them.

234421.note: The pin is on the guard station's cabin among its outbuildings, and the drawn road's turnaround ends 15 m from it.

234431.note: The lidar survey stops about 100 m west of the pin (only the highway is covered), so the layers can't show the cabin or a lane to it. On the photo the pin sits in a small opening in the conifers with a pale patch beside it, but nothing is plainly the cabin. Nothing traced.

234448.note: The pin is in the cabin's yard, among its buildings, and the drawn drive from the highway loops round the yard.

234453.note: The pin is beside the cabin's green-roofed buildings in the meadow, and the drawn road runs along the lane 30 m north. The listing's own point, 430 m northeast, is on a switchback road with nothing on it.

234454.note: The pin is on the cabin in the open meadow. Replaced the roads around it: the gravel road from Crazy Woman Canyon Road down to the cabin, its loop beside the cabin and the drive on south-east are now traced from the photo, and the straight Census lines across the meadow north and west of the cabin, which follow no visible track, are gone.

234456.note: The pin is on the cabin inside its fenced yard in the open grassland, and the drawn road ends at the yard.

234457.note: The pin sits on the drawn road by the river, about 30 m north of the light-roofed buildings that are likely the cabin, so it marks the road beside the cabin rather than the cabin.

234459.note: The pin is on the cabin in its clearing, and the drawn road reaches it. The listing's own point, 1.5 km northeast, is in unbroken pine forest.

234493.note: The pin is on a small light-roofed building in the forest, but the drawn roads pass 50 to 60 m away and no lane to it shows through the trees.

234511.note: The pin is on the cabin in its lawn clearing beside the river road, which is drawn 50 m east. The listing's own point, 1.8 km south, is in unbroken forest.

234565.note: The lidar relief shows the pin on a broad flat bench between US 12 and the creek, 50 m south of the highway, with no building-shaped gap or levelled pad on it and no lane down from the road; the photo shows only conifers there. Nothing is plainly the cabin. Nothing traced.

234607.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuilding at the meadow's edge, but the nearest drawn road is 300 m away. A dirt track runs from the cabin 250 m northwest across the meadow and fades out before any drawn road, so it isn't traced.

234654.note: The lidar relief shows a building-sized gap in the ground returns 2 to 8 m north of the pin, and the photo a small dark roof there at the east end of a bare clearing, so the pin reads as the guard cabin. The drawn road passes 60 m north-west; light bands toward the clearing show in the intensity but none plainly as a lane, so nothing is traced.

234673.note: The lidar relief shows no building-shaped gap in the ground returns, pad or clearing at the pin or within 40 m, only unbroken forest floor; the trail the photo shows through the pin shows in the relief only to its south-west. Nothing in the frame is plainly the cabin, and no road reaches it. Nothing traced.

234675.note: The pin is on the rental's building among the trees, and a drawn spur off the road ends 30 m west of it.

234713.note: The pin is on the campground road among parked trailers by the reservoir, and the listing's own point, 490 m east, is beside the highway in trees with only a faint spot by a small loop; no building in either place is plainly the guard station.

234793.note: The pin is on the station's main building in its clearing among the outbuildings, and the drawn road passes 15 m north.

250033.note: The pin is on the residence building beside the highway, and the drawn drive off the highway reaches it.

250041.note: The photo shows a green roof under the trees 58 m south-west of the listed point, where the lidar relief shows a building-sized gap in the ground returns, and the lidar intensity shows a track to it from the spur off the forest road. Moved the pin onto the roof and traced the track from the road; the rebuild re-centered the frame, so the ground layers need remaking before they can be read again.

251769.note: The pin is on the cabin at the rim's edge, and the drawn road climbs the open slope to it.

253198.note: The pin is beside the cabin in its small clearing off the road, and the drawn drive loops in to it.

253491.note: The pin is on the lookout on the open butte top, and the drawn road loops up beside it.

269838.note: The pin is on a highway pull-out (parked cars) in the forest, not on a lookout; it looks like the trailhead, and the lookout itself, up the ridge, isn't on the map.

272173.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuilding in the open pines, and the drawn spur off the loop road ends at it.
